decision_rule: PF1-EXPAND-2 (exploratory/decision-support refinement of pf1-expand-20261104, whose A1-disabled/A0 control was 0.869 at L=512). Question: first L in {384,448,512,768} where the median paired ratio tps(arm)/tps(A0) over 3 launches is >=1.00 and stays >=1.00 at larger L, for A1 (op-offload -ub 2048) and A2 (-ngl 99 -ncmoe 48); same C6/lbt 181483cfc packet, --load-threads 96, 5 timed reps per launch. Expected effect: predecessor A2 0.77@256 -> 1.12@512, A1 0.89@512 -> 1.44@1024, i.e. crossovers expected inside the grid; paired-ratio noise ~+-5-9% (A0 ran 7-9% hot), so a ratio within 1.00+-0.07 is reported as 'at crossover', not resolved. Valid only if every GPU unit proves HIP residency, capture completeness 1.0, A0 passes strict 40% node cap, and A1-disabled/A0 median within +-10% at EVERY L (guard; a failing L is unproven and the owner reruns that block/L, not the crossover claim). Stop rule: planned 3 blocks x 4 L complete (cap 2400 s); futility only (>=2 GPU units fail RUN/residency/placement, or A1-disabled diverges >25% from A0 at every L); never stop on answer before block 2. Never a PF1 gate.
